changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2 0.7: press the LFO page key again for LFO RND, two random modifiers per sound.
Each modifier offsets one of sixteen parameters by a new random amount on every note, up to its depth (0 to 64).
Port of MrScruff's rytm-mods LFO RND through rytm2_mods; 1.2.0 reaches its page through core-ar2's page tables. Sounds saved by lfo-rnd 1.0 keep their settings.
Known issue: the settings cannot be p-locked or modulated.
